Atoms.name: DatePicker
Atoms.summary: AtomDatePicker - Wrapper for Vuetify's v-date-picker Provides a visual calendar interface for date selection @example <AtomDatePicker v-model="selectedDate" :min="minDate" :max="maxDate" no-title scrollable />

Atoms.name: ListGroup
Atoms.summary: AtomListGroup - Atomic wrapper for Vuetify v-list-group A component for creating expandable groups within a list. Supports activator slot and nested content. Passes all attributes, events, and slots to the underlying v-list-group. @example <atom-list-group v-model="active"> <template v-slot:activator> <atom-list-tile> <atom-list-tile-title>Group Title</atom-list-tile-title> </atom-list-tile> </template> <atom-list…

Atoms.name: Timeline
Atoms.summary: AtomTimeline - Atomic wrapper for Vuetify v-timeline A component for displaying a timeline with items. Passes all attributes and events to the underlying v-timeline. @example <atom-timeline dense> <atom-timeline-item>Event 1</atom-timeline-item> <atom-timeline-item>Event 2</atom-timeline-item> </atom-timeline>

Atoms.name: TimelineItem
Atoms.summary: AtomTimelineItem - Atomic wrapper for Vuetify v-timeline-item A component for displaying an item within a timeline. Supports icon slot and various customization options. Passes all attributes, events, and scoped slots to the underlying v-timeline-item. @example <atom-timeline-item color="primary" fill-dot> <template #icon> <atom-icon>check</atom-icon> </template> Event description </atom-timeline-item>

Atoms.name: ToolbarTitle
Atoms.summary: AtomToolbarTitle - Atomic wrapper for Vuetify v-toolbar-title A component for displaying the title text within a toolbar. Passes all attributes and events to the underlying v-toolbar-title. @example <atom-toolbar-title>My Page Title</atom-toolbar-title>

Molecules.name: DkgRingTrio
Molecules.summary: The D/K/G trio: three concentric rings at r 56 / 42 / 28 in a 128-unit box, stroke-width 10 (docs/redesign/chassis.md § Rings).

Molecules.name: FocusPointsChip
Molecules.summary: The points chip as the focus design draws it: a flat 24/28px pill, not a Vuetify v-chip. `PointsChip` stays the chip for the legacy toolbars — it inherits `#mobileLayout .v-chip` height overrides that would fight the 64px top bar here.

Molecules.name: GettingStartedCard
Molecules.summary: "Getting started" (`Profile and About.dc.html` § AP/AT/AD).

Molecules.name: GoalActionMenu
Molecules.summary: The ⋮ action sheet. Edit, add a child, delete — the three things that used to be buttons crowding every row and a `v-menu` inside a `v-list-tile-action`. Delete is last and red; nothing here is a primary action.

Molecules.name: GoalCalendar
Molecules.summary: The Goals calendar (Goals.dc.html): a progress RING per day, not "N Goals".

Molecules.name: GoalTagsInput
Molecules.summary: Legacy call-site shim for the goal forms. See the script block: this is the old `goalTags` / `userTags` / `update-new-tag-items` contract wired to MoleculeHierarchicalTagInput, so the app has exactly ONE tag editor.

Molecules.name: GoalTaskSelector
Molecules.summary: Array of routine task items Expected structure: [{ id, name, time, tags, ... }] or with taskId: [{ taskId, name, time, tags, ... }]

Molecules.name: HierarchicalTagInput
Molecules.summary: The hierarchical `:` tag editor — the one tag input in the app.

Molecules.name: MarkdownField
Molecules.summary: A labelled markdown field with an Edit / Preview toggle.

Molecules.name: MiniSparkline
Molecules.summary: Progress' trend line (docs/redesign/chassis.md, Progress.dc.html).

Molecules.name: MobileSubDrawer

Molecules.name: MonthFocusCard
Molecules.summary: The focused month: its own goal, then its weeks as big checklist rows that EXPAND IN PLACE. Tapping a week neither navigates nor opens a modal — it unfolds its 7-day strip and its day rows directly underneath, because the week and its days are one thought and splitting them across screens is what the nested expansion panels got wrong.

Molecules.name: PriorityMoveSheet
Molecules.summary: The ⤧ move picker. One presentation per shell comes free from ResponsiveSheet; Priority overrides the dialog width to 480px (chassis.md § "Sheet vs dialog" — per-page exception).

Molecules.name: PriorityQuadrantCard
Molecules.summary: One of the FOUR cards tablet and desktop render simultaneously (Priority.dc.html PT/PD frames): a 4px colour cap, a header carrying the open count + done ring, then its own scroller.

Molecules.name: PriorityTaskList
Molecules.summary: One quadrant's items, grouped by routine in time order with a trailing "No routine" bucket; the routine whose window contains now carries the orange NOW badge (Priority.dc.html — the same grouping every list on every screen uses).

Molecules.name: PriorityTile
Molecules.summary: One cell of the phone 2x2 map (Priority.dc.html, PP frame).

Molecules.name: PriorityTriageCard
Molecules.summary: The triage card (Priority.dc.html): exactly ONE unsorted item at a time, with a ghost card 6px behind at 60% opacity when more are queued.

Molecules.name: ProfileIdentityCard
Molecules.summary: Who you are, at the top of Profile (`Profile and About.dc.html` § PP/PT/PD).

Molecules.name: ProfileRatesCard
Molecules.summary: The two read-only sections of Profile: the D / K / G point rates and the roll-up chain.

Molecules.name: ProgressBarGroup
Molecules.summary: "Tasks and Activities Completed" as the redesign draws it: three labelled 6px bars instead of `atoms/TasksCompletedCard`'s v-progress-linear trio (Progress.dc.html § doneRows).

Molecules.name: ProgressHeroCard
Molecules.summary: The Progress hero (packages/design/Progress.dc.html § GP/GT/GD).

Molecules.name: ProgressRing
Molecules.summary: The one ring the redesign draws everywhere (docs/redesign/chassis.md § Rings).

Molecules.name: PullToRefresh
Molecules.summary: Pull down to refresh, for touch screens. Wraps any content; when a downward drag starts while every scroller under the finger (inside this wrapper) is already at its top, an indicator follows the finger down and, released past `threshold`, emits `refresh`. The host does the refetch and reports it back through `refreshing`, which keeps the indicator spinning until it is false.

Molecules.name: RelatedTasksTimeline
Molecules.summary: The rows grouped by date, keeping the incoming order (newest day first). Within a day, goals with a routine time come in time order; the rest keep their place after them.

Molecules.name: ResponsiveSheet
Molecules.summary: One overlay, two presentations — docs/redesign/chassis.md § "Sheet vs dialog". Every design file draws the same sheet twice (phone bottom sheet, tablet / desktop centred dialog), so this is one component with a `shell` prop rather than a sheet and a dialog that drift apart.

Molecules.name: RoutineRail
Molecules.summary: Today's routines as a list. Two shapes, one data source: - `rows` (desktop sidebar): 46px rows with time, state icon, name and a stimulus letter pill. - `chips` (iPad mini): 32px horizontally-scrolling pills. Clicking either focuses that routine.

Molecules.name: RoutineRankCard
Molecules.summary: "Great going" / "Needs attention" - the top three and bottom three routines by score (Progress.dc.html § good/bad). Replaces the generic `molecules/TableCard` this page used to render twice.

Molecules.name: SlidingSwitch
Molecules.summary: The segmented control the redesign uses four times: Progress (Day · Week · Month · Year), Profile (12h / 24h), About (5 feature tabs) and the agent event kind (URL / cURL). Two variants, one geometry generalised from Progress:

Molecules.name: StatusRing
Molecules.summary: The agent lifecycle ring (Agents.dc.html; chassis § Rings / § Motion).

Molecules.name: SubtaskEditor
Molecules.summary: SUBTASKS on the goal-item page — progress bar, editable rows, add row.

Molecules.name: TimingReportCard
Molecules.summary: On the clock: how the period's routine check-ins landed against their windows. The detailed version of the drawer's day ribbon: - the period's on-time rate and one bar split on time / late / missed; - a stacked bar per day (per routine on Day, per month on Year); - the weekday rhythm, coloured by each day's on-time rate; - every routine, the ones slipping first. Pure: props in, `open-routine` out.

Molecules.name: TimingRibbon
Molecules.summary: Today on the clock: one segment per routine, in the order the day runs, coloured by how its check-in landed. The next one still to come pulses, so the ribbon reads as "where the day is" as much as "how it went". Under it, the rolling week's on-time rate and its change on the week before.

Molecules.name: YearGoalHero
Molecules.summary: The hero: ring + title + status chip + ONE rule line, and on the phone the routine chip, the ‹ › goal steppers and the collapsible "ABOUT THIS GOAL".

Molecules.name: YearMonthStrip
Molecules.summary: The 12-month strip that replaced the nested expansion panels. Tap a month to focus it; the focus card below is the only place a month's weeks and days live, so there is no second level of accordion anywhere on this page.

Organisms.summary: The five feature tabs (`Profile and About.dc.html` § AP/AT/AD).

Organisms.name: AgentList
Organisms.summary: The Agents page list column (`packages/design/Agents.dc.html`, frames #ap/#at/#ad): three stat tiles over one card per agent.

Organisms.summary: MarkdownEditor doesn't participate in v-model for a nested prop cleanly (it emits 'input'), so we write the new description onto localMilestoneData explicitly. The deep watcher then propagates it to the parent container via update:milestoneData.

Organisms.summary: Connect AI — the MCP credentials and the four setup guides (`Profile and About.dc.html` § PP/PT/PD).

Organisms.summary: Exact match after a trim — `delete`, `Delete` and `DELETE now` all fail.

Organisms.name: GoalCascade
Organisms.summary: The Goals screen body (packages/design/Goals.dc.html).

Organisms.name: GoalCreation
Organisms.summary: Push the item to the next day. `updateGoalItem` already relocates the subdocument between date documents and stamps originalDate / rescheduled (server resolvers/goal.js moveGoalItem), so a defer is just a save with tomorrow's date — no second code path to keep in step.

Organisms.name: GoalDeleteSheet
Organisms.summary: Deleting a goal item, confirmed in a chassis sheet.

Organisms.name: GoalItemSheet
Organisms.summary: The goal-item page — `sheetGoal` in `packages/design/Routine Notes Final.dc.html`.

Organisms.name: GoalTaskToolbar
Organisms.summary: Whether to render child selectors in mobile sub-drawer mode

Organisms.name: GroupInviteSheet
Organisms.summary: Invite by email. One overlay, two presentations, through the chassis' ResponsiveSheet: a bottom sheet on phone, a 560px centred modal on tablet and desktop (the per-page width exception the chassis allows).

Organisms.name: GroupJoinRequest
Organisms.summary: Someone has invited you into their group. Accepting leaves the group you are in now, which is why the card says so under the buttons rather than in a toast after the fact.

Organisms.name: GroupLeaveSheet
Organisms.summary: Leaving the group, confirmed in a real sheet.

Organisms.name: GroupMemberList
Organisms.summary: The members card: a header, the member rows (passed in through the default slot so each one can own its own read), the pending-invite rows, and the in-list "Invite someone" row that dims and relabels when the group is full.

Organisms.name: GroupMemberRow
Organisms.summary: One row of the Groups member list.

Organisms.name: GroupMemberWeek
Organisms.summary: One member's week: three stat tiles and a routines x days grid.

Organisms.name: GroupPulseCard
Organisms.summary: The group pulse — what replaced the forest stock photo and its member count (Groups.dc.html § "What changed from FamilyRoutine.vue").

Organisms.name: InboxSheet
Organisms.summary: The Inbox — `sheetInbox` in `packages/design/Routine Notes Final.dc.html`.

Organisms.name: PriorityBoard
Organisms.summary: The Priority page body (packages/design/Priority.dc.html).

Organisms.name: ProfileTimeSettings
Organisms.summary: Profile's TIME card: the two settings a user can actually change, plus the one that is fixed (`Profile and About.dc.html` § PP/PT/PD).

Organisms.name: ProgressReport
Organisms.summary: The Progress screen body (packages/design/Progress.dc.html).

Organisms.name: QuickGoalCreation
Organisms.summary: Start Work — `sheetAction` in `packages/design/Routine Notes Final.dc.html`, the sheet the tick ring on an unticked routine opens.

Organisms.name: RoutineBriefCard
Organisms.summary: "Before you start" — the area/project brief pinned as the first item in a routine's thread (design handoff § "Areas and projects live in chat").

Organisms.name: RoutineCascadePanel
Organisms.summary: Week / Month / Year panel shown inside the focus card when a cascade tab is active. One goal, its unit grid, and what it rolls up into.

Organisms.name: RoutineChatThread
Organisms.summary: The routine's conversation. Bubbles, centred event pills, embedded live checkbox rows, "break it down" proposals with an Add-all button, and quick-reply chips under the last message only.

Organisms.name: RoutineComposer
Organisms.summary: "Message Start Work…" — the composer under the focus card. The "+" opens the AI Search sheet; focusing the input collapses the checklist so the thread gets the height (design handoff § Composer).

Organisms.name: RoutineDayPlan
Organisms.summary: The Routines screen's body: a 24-hour day dial and the timeline it shares its data with (packages/design/Routines.dc.html).

Organisms.name: RoutineDeck
Organisms.summary: Phone card deck: the focus card, in the default slot.

Organisms.name: RoutineEditorSheet
Organisms.summary: The Routines editor (packages/design/Routines.dc.html § the sheet).

Organisms.name: RoutineFocusCard
Organisms.summary: The focus card: one routine, concentrated. Status window at the top, the tick ring and title in the middle, then the checklist, then whatever the shell puts in the `thread` slot (the routine chat) — all in ONE scroll area, because the design treats checklist and conversation as a single column. Period tabs are pinned full-bleed to the bottom of the card.

Organisms.name: RoutineTopBar
Organisms.summary: Phone top bar. "Home" fades out once the focused routine is ticked and the centre slot takes over: a 34px green ring plus the routine name, popped in after the tick animation lands. That ring is also the flight TARGET, so the page measures it through `ringTargetRect()` / `nameTargetRect()`.

Organisms.name: SkipDaySheet
Organisms.summary: Skip day — `sheetSkip` in `packages/design/Routine Notes Final.dc.html`.

Organisms.name: UserDrawer
Organisms.summary: The left drawer the avatar opens. D/K/G moved here out of the home screen (design handoff § User drawer) so the home screen can be only the focused routine.

Organisms.name: WeekdaySelector
Organisms.summary: How much cell there is around the ring in the compact (header) form: the design's iPad and desktop frames both draw a 28px ring in a 38px cell. The cell does not stretch there — the strip sits beside the date at a 40px pitch (38 + the 2px gap), it does not spread across the row.

Organisms.summary: One year goal, laid out per shell.
